name: GFL Limited
summary: GFL Limited operates multiplexes in India. It also engages in real estate and property development activities, as well as the distribution of investment products, including mutual funds. The company was formerly known as Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited and changed its name to GFL Limited in July 2019. GFL Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Mumbai, India. GFL Limited was formerly a subsidiary of Inox Leasing and Finance Limited.
